A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. <script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const backdrop = new THREE.Mesh(

    uniforms: {

      low: { value: new THREE.Color(0xd2d6d4) },
      warm: { value: new THREE.Color(0xf8f6ef) }
    },
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 paper;
      void main() {
        paper = position.xy;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      varying vec2 paper;
      uniform vec3 high;
      uniform vec3 low;
      uniform vec3 warm;
      float hash(vec2 p) {
        return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(127.1, 311.7))) * 43758.5453);
      }
      float cloud(vec2 p) {
        vec2 i = floor(p), f = fract(p);
        f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
        return mix(mix(hash(i), hash(i + vec2(1,0)), f.x),
                   mix(hash(i + vec2(0,1)), hash(i + vec2(1,1)), f.x), f.y);
      }
      void main() {
        float bank = -77.0 + 7.0 * sin(paper.x * .033)
                     + 11.0 * (cloud(paper * .027 + 8.0) - .5);
        float ground = 1.0 - smoothstep(bank - 30.0, bank + 15.0, paper.y);
        vec3 c = mix(high, low, ground * .96);
        c = mix(c, warm, .23 * cloud(paper * .021 + 14.0) * (1.0-ground));
        c += (cloud(paper * .088) - .5) * .024;
        c += (hash(gl_FragCoord.xy) - .5) * .011;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(c, 1.0);

    `
  })

const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const V = (x, y, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);
const pixel = (x, y, z) => V(x - 108, 108 - y, z);
const clamp = THREE.MathUtils.clamp;
const smooth = THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep;
const gold = new THREE.Color(0xd5a331);
const goldLight = new THREE.Color(0xe0b442);
const goldShade = new THREE.Color(0xa66c20);
const belly = new THREE.Color(0xc29d77);
const bellyEdge = new THREE.Color(0xbf9568);
const palmColor = new THREE.Color(0x514a37);
const fingerColor = new THREE.Color(0x494335);
const skinMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xffffff, vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.95
});
const handMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xffffff, vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.94
});
const toothMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xf8eacd, roughness: 0.78
});

function group(name, parent, position) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = name;
  if (position) g.position.copy(position);
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}

function atPixel(name, parent, x, y, z) {
  parent.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
  return group(name, parent, parent.worldToLocal(pixel(x, y, z)));
}

function mesh(parent, name, geometry, material) {
  const object = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  object.name = name;
  parent.add(object);
  return object;
}

function colorMesh(positions, colors, indices) {
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  if (colors.length) geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  return geo;
}

function joinRings(indices, ringCount, sides, reverse = false) {
  for (let j = 0; j < ringCount - 1; j++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = j * sides + i;
      const b = j * sides + (i + 1) % sides;
      const c = a + sides;
      const d = b + sides;
      if (reverse) indices.push(a, c, b, b, c, d);
      else indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c);
    }
  }
}

function curvedVolume(points, radii, shade, steps = 40, sides = 40) {
  const guide = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points, false, 'catmullrom', 0.43);
  const profile = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
    radii.map(([x, z], i) => V(x, z, i)), false, 'catmullrom', 0.4
  );
  const frames = guide.computeFrenetFrames(steps, false);
  const positions = [];
  const colors = [];
  const indices = [];
  const across = V(0, 0, 0);
  const depth = V(0, 0, 0);
  for (let j = 0; j <= steps; j++) {
    const t = j / steps;
    const center = guide.getPointAt(t);
    const radius = profile.getPoint(guide.getUtoTmapping(t));
    const tangent = frames.tangents[j];
    across.crossVectors(V(0, 0, 1), tangent);
    if (across.lengthSq() < 0.00001) across.copy(frames.normals[j]);
    across.normalize();
    depth.crossVectors(tangent, across).normalize();
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = i / sides * TAU;
      const u = Math.cos(a);
      const v = Math.sin(a);
      const p = center.clone()
        .addScaledVector(across, u * Math.max(0.04, radius.x))
        .addScaledVector(depth, v * Math.max(0.04, radius.y));
      positions.push(p.x, p.y, p.z);
      if (shade) {
        const c = shade(t, u, v, p);
        colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
      }
    }
  }
  joinRings(indices, steps + 1, sides);
  for (let i = 1; i < sides - 1; i++) {
    indices.push(0, i + 1, i);
    const end = steps * sides;
    indices.push(end, end + i, end + i + 1);
  }
  return colorMesh(positions, colors, indices);
}

function skinShade(t, u, v) {
  return gold.clone().lerp(goldLight, 0.17 + 0.13 * v)
    .lerp(goldShade, 0.12 * Math.max(0, -v) + 0.08 * Math.pow(t, 3));
}

function limb(parent, name, rows, shade = skinShade) {
  const pivot = atPixel(name, parent, ...rows[0].slice(0, 3));
  pivot.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
  const points = rows.map(row => pivot.worldToLocal(pixel(...row.slice(0, 3))));
  const radii = rows.map(row => row.slice(3));
  mesh(pivot, name + '-skin', curvedVolume(points, radii, shade), skinMaterial);
  return pivot;
}

const torso = group('torso', character);
const torsoRows = [
  [48,110,-8, 0.5, 0.5],
  [52,111,-8, 18, 15],
  [61,113,-9, 32, 25],
  [78,116,-11, 40, 32],
  [97,119,-11, 43, 36],
  [115,121,-10, 44, 40],
  [137,123,-9, 45, 41],
  [155,124,-8, 44, 38],
  [170,125,-8, 38, 32],
  [183,125,-8, 28, 25],
  [190,125,-8, 17, 15],
  [193,125,-8, 0.5, 0.5]
];

const torsoGeometry = curvedVolume(
  torsoRows.map(([y,x,z]) => pixel(x,y,z)),
  torsoRows.map(row => row.slice(3)),
  (t, u, v, p) => {
    const y = 108 - p.y;
    const x = p.x + 108;
    const middle = 117.0 - (y - 139) * 0.13;
    const dy = (y - 139) / 30.2;
    const dx = (x - middle) / (34.5 - 2.9 * smooth(y, 145, 170));
    const outline = Math.pow(Math.abs(dx), 2.45) + Math.pow(Math.abs(dy), 2.10);
    const patch = (1 - smooth(outline, 0.96, 1.045)) * smooth(v, 0.05, 0.32);
    const grain = Math.sin(x * 1.7 + y * 1.4) * Math.cos(y * 2.1 - x * 0.42);
    const bodyGold = skinShade(t, u, v).lerp(goldShade, 0.11 * Math.pow(Math.abs(u), 3));
    const patchColor = belly.clone().lerp(bellyEdge, 0.27 * Math.max(0, dy) + 0.11 * dx * dx);
    return bodyGold.lerp(patchColor, patch).multiplyScalar(1 + 0.014 * grain);
  },
  104, 128
);
mesh(torso, 'rounded-body-and-belly-patch', torsoGeometry, skinMaterial);

limb(torso, 'neck', [

  [60,120,10,26,23],
  [74,121,5,27,26],

const leftLeg = limb(character, 'leg-image-left', [

const rightLeg = limb(character, 'leg-image-right', [

function ellipsoid(parent, name, position, scale, color) {

  object.scale.set(...scale);
  return object;
}
for (const [leg, x, z, width] of [[leftLeg, 105, 15, 15], [rightLeg, 159, 12, 18]]) {

const leftArm = limb(character, 'arm-image-left', [
  [54,96,-5,1,1],

], (t, u, v) => skinShade(t, u, v).lerp(goldShade, 0.30 * Math.max(0, u) * smooth(t, .26, .73)));

const rightArm = limb(character, 'arm-image-right', [
  [52,144,-5,1,1],
  [66,151,-4,14.2,17],
  [85,162,-1,18.7,21],
  [105,171,5,22.5,25],
  [124,173,15,23.5,27],
  [141,170,25,20.9,25],
  [156,164,35,15.6,20],
  [171,159,45,11.2,14],
  [180,158,48,8.2,9.5]
], (t, u, v) => skinShade(t, u, v).lerp(goldShade,
  0.26 * Math.max(0, -u) * smooth(t, .25, .52) + 0.08 * smooth(t, .68, 1)));

function hand(parent, name, base, palm, fingers) {
  const pivot = atPixel(name, parent, ...base);
  const surface = (t, u, v) => palmColor.clone().multiplyScalar(0.86 + 0.18 * Math.max(0, v));
  mesh(pivot, 'palm', curvedVolume(
    palm.map(row => V(...row.slice(0, 3))), palm.map(row => row.slice(3)), surface, 26, 32
  ), handMaterial);
  for (const [fingerName, rows] of fingers) {
    const start = V(...rows[0].slice(0, 3));
    const digit = group(fingerName, pivot, start);
    const points = rows.map(row => V(...row.slice(0, 3)).sub(start));
    const radii = rows.map(row => [row[3], row[3] * (row[4] || 0.76)]);
    mesh(digit, 'rounded-digit', curvedVolume(points, radii, (t, u, v) =>
      fingerColor.clone().lerp(palmColor, (1 - t) * .56)
        .multiplyScalar(.87 + .16 * Math.max(v, 0)), 24, 18), handMaterial);
  }
}

hand(leftArm, 'hand-image-left', [88.7, 176.2, 41], [
  [1,4,-1,2.8,2.9], [0,1,0,6.5,4.9], [-1.4,-3.2,1.7,8.3,5.1],
  [-2.6,-7,2.7,7.4,4.5], [-3,-10,1.8,3,2.5], [-3.3,-11.5,1,0.2,0.2]
], [

  ['ring-finger', [[-4.3,-7.1,4.2,2.8],[-6.8,-12.7,5.1,2.4],[-7.7,-17.6,4.6,2.0],[-7.1,-20.5,3.7,1.45],[-6.5,-21.2,3.4,.13]]],
  ['middle-finger', [[-.7,-7.3,4.7,2.75],[-2.4,-12.8,5.8,2.3],[-1.8,-17.8,4.8,1.9],[-1.2,-19.7,4.0,1.0],[-.9,-20.1,3.6,.11]]],
  ['index-finger', [[2.4,-6,4.5,2.55],[2.9,-10.8,5.7,2.35],[4.2,-14.4,5.1,2],[4.4,-16.8,4.2,1.4],[4.1,-17.6,3.9,.12]]],
  ['thumb', [[4.7,-1.3,2.6,3.3],[7.4,-5.7,4.7,2.8],[9.6,-9.4,5.0,2.2],[9.4,-12.2,4.0,1.4],[8.9,-12.8,3.7,.13]]]
]);

hand(rightArm, 'hand-image-right', [157.4, 179.6, 53], [
  [2.2,5,-1,4,3.7], [1.1,2,0,8.6,5.5], [0,-2.9,1.7,10.4,6.2],
  [-.7,-7.1,2.0,9.2,5.6], [-.3,-10,1.9,4.3,3.0], [0,-11.8,1.6,.2,.2]
], [
  ['thumb', [[-6.0,-1.3,3.3,3.55],[-9.4,-5.5,5.1,3.15],[-12,-9.9,5.4,2.55],[-12.6,-13,4.6,1.95],[-12.3,-14.7,4,.15]]],
  ['index-finger', [[-4.7,-6,5.1,3.2],[-6.2,-11.6,6.0,2.9],[-6.6,-16.4,5.2,2.45],[-5.9,-19.9,4.4,1.8],[-5.4,-20.6,4.0,.15]]],
  ['middle-finger', [[-.1,-7.0,5.8,3.25],[.4,-12.8,7.0,2.95],[1.5,-17.8,6.1,2.55],[2.5,-21.0,4.9,1.65],[3.1,-21.6,4.6,.14]]],
  ['ring-finger', [[4.2,-5.9,5.5,3.05],[6.1,-11.4,6.1,2.8],[8.3,-15.9,5.4,2.4],[9.9,-18.3,4.3,1.65],[10.6,-18.6,3.9,.13]]],
  ['little-finger', [[7.6,-3.7,3.9,2.65],[10.4,-7.4,4.9,2.45],[12.6,-10.1,4.6,2.1],[14.4,-11.7,3.7,1.55],[15.2,-11.7,3.4,.14]]]
]);

const head = atPixel('head', character, 120, 46, 24);
head.rotation.z = -0.242;
const rx = 29.4;
const ry = 34.6;
const rz = 26.9;

function faceZ(x, y) {
  return rz * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - (x / rx) ** 2 - (y / ry) ** 2));
}

const mouthShape = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
  V(-16.0,8.1,0), V(-13.4,12.1,0), V(-6.0,13.0,0),
  V(2.4,12.6,0), V(10.9,11.8,0), V(17.1,8.7,0),
  V(17.7,4.3,0), V(15.0,-4.8,0), V(10.2,-13.8,0),
  V(4.3,-21.7,0), V(-3.2,-25.4,0), V(-9.7,-23.5,0),
  V(-13.6,-18.3,0), V(-15.9,-8.5,0), V(-16.7,1.4,0)
], true, 'catmullrom', .44);

const faceSides = 128;
const faceRings = 44;
const backRings = 24;
const outline = [];
const surfacePositions = [];
const surfaceColors = [];
const surfaceIndices = [];
const ochreLip = new THREE.Color(0xb3832b);
const headGold = new THREE.Color(0xe0b542);
const lipHighlight = new THREE.Color(0xe9c15e);

for (let i = 0; i < faceSides; i++) {
  const p = mouthShape.getPointAt(i / faceSides);
  const dx = p.x;
  const dy = p.y + 5;
  const a = (dx / rx) ** 2 + (dy / ry) ** 2;
  const b = -10 * dy / (ry * ry);
  const c = (5 / ry) ** 2 - 1;
  const k = (-b + Math.sqrt(b * b - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a);
  outline.push({ p, x: k * dx, y: -5 + k * dy });
}

for (let j = 0; j <= faceRings + backRings; j++) {
  for (const {p, x, y} of outline) {
    let px, py, pz, color;
    if (j <= faceRings) {
      const t = j / faceRings;
      const s = Math.sin(t * Math.PI / 2);
      px = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(p.x, x, s);
      py = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(p.y, y, s);
      const lip = Math.exp(-((t - .065) / .057) ** 2);
      pz = faceZ(px, py) + lip * (py < -10 ? 1.22 : 0.66);
      color = headGold.clone().lerp(goldShade, 0.17 * (1 - smooth(py, -30, -4)));
      color.lerp(ochreLip, (1 - smooth(t, 0, .084)) * .57);
      color.lerp(lipHighlight, lip * .43 * (1 - smooth(py, -18, -7)));
      const grain = Math.sin(px * 1.46 + py * .91) * Math.sin(py * 2.07 - px * .59);
      color.multiplyScalar(1 + .017 * grain);
    } else {
      const a = (j - faceRings) / backRings * (Math.PI / 2 - .001);
      px = x * Math.cos(a);
      py = y * Math.cos(a);
      pz = -rz * Math.sin(a);
      color = headGold.clone().lerp(gold, .25 * Math.sin(a));
      color.lerp(goldShade, 0.17 * (1 - smooth(py, -30, -4)));
    }
    surfacePositions.push(px, py, pz);
    surfaceColors.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
  }
}
joinRings(surfaceIndices, faceRings + backRings + 1, faceSides);
const rearEnd = (faceRings + backRings) * faceSides;
for (let i = 1; i < faceSides - 1; i++) surfaceIndices.push(rearEnd, rearEnd + i, rearEnd + i + 1);
mesh(head, 'sculpted-head-with-mouth-opening',
  colorMesh(surfacePositions, surfaceColors, surfaceIndices), skinMaterial);

const mouth = group('mouth', head);
const cavityPositions = [];
const cavityColors = [];
const cavityIndices = [];
const throatDark = new THREE.Color(0x0a0604);
const innerWall = new THREE.Color(0x41271a);
const cavityRings = 23;
for (let j = 0; j <= cavityRings; j++) {
  const t = j / cavityRings;
  for (const {p} of outline) {
    const x = p.x * (1 - t) - .8 * t;
    const y = (p.y + 5.8) * (1 - t) - 5.8;
    const z = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(faceZ(p.x, p.y) + .12, 5.6, Math.sin(t * Math.PI / 2));
    cavityPositions.push(x, y, z);
    const rim = (1 - smooth(t, 0, .25)) * (.48 + .32 * (1 - smooth(p.y, -24, 2)));
    const color = throatDark.clone().lerp(innerWall, rim);
    cavityColors.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
  }
}
joinRings(cavityIndices, cavityRings + 1, faceSides, true);
mesh(mouth, 'recessed-mouth-interior', colorMesh(cavityPositions, cavityColors, cavityIndices),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ vertexColors: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide }));

function faceStroke(parent, name, points, color, roughness = 0.88) {
  const center = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(([x, y, inset]) =>
    V(x, y, faceZ(x, y) + inset)), false, 'catmullrom', .46);
  const radii = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map((p, i) =>
    V(p[3], i, 0)), false, 'catmullrom', .43);
  const tubePositions = [];
  const indices = [];
  const steps = 36;
  const sides = 12;
  const frames = center.computeFrenetFrames(steps, false);
  for (let j = 0; j <= steps; j++) {
    const t = j / steps;
    const p = center.getPointAt(t);
    const radius = Math.max(.055, radii.getPoint(center.getUtoTmapping(t)).x);
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = i * TAU / sides;
      const q = p.clone().addScaledVector(frames.normals[j], Math.cos(a) * radius)
        .addScaledVector(frames.binormals[j], Math.sin(a) * radius);
      tubePositions.push(q.x, q.y, q.z);
    }
  }
  joinRings(indices, steps + 1, sides, true);
  return mesh(parent, name, colorMesh(tubePositions, [], indices),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness, side: THREE.DoubleSide }));
}

function tooth(name, x, y, w, h, angle, depth) {
  const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 16, 12);
  const vertices = geo.attributes.position;
  const ca = Math.cos(angle);
  const sa = Math.sin(angle);
  for (let i = 0; i < vertices.count; i++) {
    const bx = vertices.getX(i);
    const by = vertices.getY(i);
    const bz = vertices.getZ(i);
    const u = Math.sign(bx) * Math.pow(Math.abs(bx), .71) * w * .5 * (1 + .18 * by);
    const v = Math.sign(by) * Math.pow(Math.abs(by), .71) * h * .5;
    const fx = x + u * ca - v * sa;
    const fy = y + u * sa + v * ca;
    vertices.setXYZ(i, fx, fy, faceZ(fx, fy) + depth + 1.26 * bz);
  }
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  mesh(teeth, name, geo, toothMaterial);
}
